```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(neuralnet)
library(caret)
library(whychusInputs)
```

# Configuration

Edit these values before running.

```{r config}
m_start <- 5     # May
m_stop  <- 9     # September

h          <- 5      # number of hidden layers
p          <- 0.2    # test proportion (fraction held out)
iterations <- 1e5    # stepmax for neuralnet
lag        <- "yes_tar"  # "no", "yes", or "yes_tar"

output_dir  <- here::here("output")
output_name <- "rm85_ann_results.csv"

plot_results <- TRUE
```

# 1. Build Joined Dataset

## 1a. RM 8.5 target (daily max temperature)

```{r rm85-target}
rm85_target <- rm_8_5_historical |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  filter(statistic == "max") |>
  select(date, Tmax = temperature)
```

## 1b. Camp Polk flow and temperature

```{r camp-polk}
cp_flow <- camp_polk_historical |>
  filter(variable == "discharge (cfs)", statistic == "mean") |>
  select(date, Q = value)

cp_temp <- camp_polk_historical |>
  filter(variable == "water temperature (c)", statistic == "max") |>
  select(date, cp_tmax = value)
```

## 1c. Weather forecasts (day-1 lead)

```{r forecasts}
fcst <- all_historical_forecasts |>
  filter(lead_days == 1) |>
  select(valid_date, variable, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) |>
  rename(
    date      = valid_date,
    air_max   = temperature_2m_max,
    air_min   = temperature_2m_min,
    cloud_pct = cloud_cover_mean
  )
```

## 1d. Join and filter to season

```{r join}
df_full <- rm85_target |>
  left_join(cp_flow,  by = "date") |>
  left_join(cp_temp,  by = "date") |>
  left_join(fcst,     by = "date") |>
  mutate(
    month  = month(date),
    Julian = yday(date),
    year   = year(date)
  ) |>
  filter(month >= m_start, month <= m_stop) |>
  filter(!is.na(Tmax), !is.na(Q), !is.na(air_max), !is.na(air_min)) |>
  arrange(date)

cat("Rows after filtering:", nrow(df_full), "\n")
glimpse(df_full)
```

# 2. Build Feature Matrices

Three versions, matching the mfjd-ann structure:

| Name | Lag | Features |
|------|-----|----------|
| X_0 | none | Q, cp_tmax, Julian, air_max, air_min, cloud_pct |
| X_M1 | predictors t-1 | X_0 + Q_m1, cp_tmax_m1, air_max_m1, air_min_m1 |
| X_M1_tar | predictors + target t-1 | X_M1 + Tmax_m1 |

```{r feature-matrices}
n <- nrow(df_full)

# --- No lag ---
X_0   <- df_full |> select(Q, cp_tmax, Julian, air_max, air_min, cloud_pct)
tar_0 <- df_full$Tmax

# --- Predictor lag ---
current <- df_full |> slice(2:n)
lagged  <- df_full |> slice(1:(n - 1))

X_M1 <- tibble(
  Q          = current$Q,
  cp_tmax    = current$cp_tmax,
  Julian     = current$Julian,
  air_max    = current$air_max,
  air_min    = current$air_min,
  cloud_pct  = current$cloud_pct,
  Q_m1       = lagged$Q,
  cp_tmax_m1 = lagged$cp_tmax,
  air_max_m1 = lagged$air_max,
  air_min_m1 = lagged$air_min
)
tar_M1 <- current$Tmax

# --- Predictor + target lag ---
X_M1_tar <- X_M1 |>
  mutate(Tmax_m1 = lagged$Tmax)
tar_M1_tar <- tar_M1

# Select based on config
if (lag == "no") {
  X   <- X_0
  tar <- tar_0
} else if (lag == "yes") {
  X   <- X_M1
  tar <- tar_M1
} else if (lag == "yes_tar") {
  X   <- X_M1_tar
  tar <- tar_M1_tar
}

# Drop any remaining NAs introduced by lagging
keep <- complete.cases(X) & !is.na(tar)
X   <- X[keep, ]
tar <- tar[keep]

# Carry dates through — same length as X and tar after keep filter
if (lag == "no") {
  dates_model <- df_full$date[keep]
} else {
  dates_model <- df_full$date[2:n][keep]
}

cat("Features:", ncol(X), "\n")
cat("Rows for modeling:", nrow(X), "\n")
```

# 3. Train / Test Split and Scaling

```{r scale}
set.seed(42)
train_idx <- caret::createDataPartition(tar, p = 1 - p, list = FALSE)

X_train     <- X[train_idx, ]
X_test      <- X[-train_idx, ]
y_train     <- tar[train_idx]
y_test      <- tar[-train_idx]
dates_test  <- dates_model[-train_idx]   # aligned to test rows

# Standard scaler fit on training data only
preproc        <- preProcess(X_train, method = c("center", "scale"))
X_train_scaled <- predict(preproc, X_train)
X_test_scaled  <- predict(preproc, X_test)

cat("Train rows:", nrow(X_train_scaled), "\n")
cat("Test rows: ", nrow(X_test_scaled),  "\n")
stopifnot(length(dates_test) == length(y_test))  # sanity check
```

# 4. Fit ANN

Hidden layer size = `ncol(X) + 1` repeated `h` times, matching the mfjd approach.

```{r fit-ann}
hidden_size   <- ncol(X) + 1
hidden_layers <- rep(hidden_size, h)

cat("Hidden layer architecture:", paste(hidden_layers, collapse = " → "), "\n")

train_df <- as.data.frame(X_train_scaled) |>
  mutate(target = y_train)

set.seed(42)
model <- neuralnet(
  target ~ Q + cp_tmax + Julian + air_max + air_min + cloud_pct +
           Q_m1 + cp_tmax_m1 + air_max_m1 + air_min_m1 + Tmax_m1,
  data    = train_df,
  hidden  = c(5, 3),
  linear.output = TRUE,
  stepmax = 1e6
)

cat("Training complete.\n")
```

# 5. Evaluate

```{r evaluate}
# data.matrix() ensures a plain numeric matrix — tibble columns confuse neuralnet
y_pred <- neuralnet::compute(model, data.matrix(X_test_scaled))$net.result[, 1]

SSres <- sum((y_pred - y_test)^2)
SStot <- sum((y_test - mean(y_test))^2)
R2    <- 1 - SSres / SStot
RMSE  <- sqrt(SSres / length(y_pred))
MAE   <- mean(abs(y_pred - y_test))

cat(sprintf("R²:   %.4f\n", R2))
cat(sprintf("RMSE: %.4f °C\n", RMSE))
cat(sprintf("MAE:  %.4f °C\n", MAE))
```

# 6. Diagnostic Plots

## 6a. Predicted vs Observed

```{r plot-pred-obs}
plot_df <- tibble(predicted = y_pred, observed = y_test)
ax_max  <- ceiling(max(c(y_pred, y_test)) * 1.05)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = predicted, y = observed)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "#185FA5", size = 1.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              color = "#E24B4A", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, ax_max), ylim = c(0, ax_max)) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.05 * ax_max, y = 0.95 * ax_max, hjust = 0,
           label = sprintf("R² = %.3f\nRMSE = %.2f °C", R2, RMSE),
           size = 4, color = "grey30") +
  labs(
    title    = sprintf("ANN — RM 8.5 max daily temperature (%d hidden layers)", h),
    subtitle = sprintf("lag = '%s'  |  features = %d", lag, ncol(X)),
    x = "Predicted Tmax (°C)", y = "Observed Tmax (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## 6b. Residuals vs Predicted

```{r plot-residuals}
plot_df |>
  mutate(residual = observed - predicted) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = predicted, y = residual)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#74A089", size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#E24B4A",
              linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Residuals vs Predicted — RM 8.5 ANN",
    x = "Predicted Tmax (°C)", y = "Residual (obs − pred, °C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## 6c. Time-Series Comparison (Test Set)

```{r plot-timeseries}
tibble(
  date      = dates_test,
  observed  = y_test,
  predicted = y_pred
) |>
  pivot_longer(c(observed, predicted), names_to = "series", values_to = "temp") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = temp, color = series)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(observed = "#185FA5", predicted = "#E24B4A"),
                     name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Test-set time series — RM 8.5 ANN",
    x = NULL, y = "Max water temp (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# 7. Results Summary

```{r results-table}
results <- tibble(
  target        = "RM 8.5 Tmax",
  lag           = lag,
  n_features    = ncol(X),
  hidden_layers = h,
  hidden_size   = hidden_size,
  n_train       = nrow(X_train),
  n_test        = nrow(X_test),
  R2            = round(R2,   4),
  RMSE          = round(RMSE, 4),
  MAE           = round(MAE,  4)
)

print(results)

dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write_csv(results, file.path(output_dir, output_name))
```

# 8. Save Model and Scaler

```{r save-model}
saveRDS(model,   file.path(output_dir, "rm85_ann_model.rds"))
saveRDS(preproc, file.path(output_dir, "rm85_scaler.rds"))

cat("Model saved to:  ", file.path(output_dir, "rm85_ann_model.rds"), "\n")
cat("Scaler saved to: ", file.path(output_dir, "rm85_scaler.rds"),    "\n")
```
